hero.subtitle: Hi, my name is
hero.title: Serhii Deineko.
hero.subtitleLarge: I build IT solutions for businesses.

items.title: Customer Communication Platform for InPost
items.description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I worked on the InPost project — an internal application for centralizing customer communication, embedded within the Genesys Cloud platform. It includes a search engine with advanced interaction filtering and a preview and management module for supervisors.
items.small-description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I was responsible for the entire frontend of an application for InPost that handles intelligent search and end-to-end processing of customer inquiries coming from a variety of communication channels.

key-points.title: Layered Angular architecture
key-points.description: Frontend architecture in Angular 21 in zoneless mode (Standalone) in a layered structure (Core / Pages / Shared) with state management using Angular Signals.

key-points.title: Context-aware components
key-points.description: Context-aware component pattern (dependency injection) supporting various table and filter schemas.

key-points.title: Bulk operations engine
key-points.description: Bulk operations engine based on RxJS with background task polling and session recovery.

items.title: Smart EU Funding Discovery Platform 🇪🇺
items.description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I was responsible for the entire frontend of AISEMA — a SaaS platform that streamlines the acquisition of EU grants (including Horizon Europe). It helps researchers and coordinators quickly find funding and partners for their projects.
items.small-description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I was responsible for the entire frontend of the AISEMA platform, which streamlines the search for grants and project partners.

key-points.title: SPA architecture & state
key-points.description: Responsible for the entire client layer and SPA architecture in Vue 3 (Composition API) with central state (Pinia).

key-points.title: Multi-step search wizard
key-points.description: Designed a multi-step search wizard from competition, through related projects, to partner selection (scroll-driven — IntersectionObserver).

key-points.title: Analytical dashboards
key-points.description: Implemented interactive analytical dashboards with a custom algorithm for spreading overlapping points in dense datasets.

key-points.title: Data layer & WebGL visuals
key-points.description: Client-side data normalization layer and advanced home page visualization (WebGL shaders).

items.title: Callback Widget for InPost
items.description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I worked on the InPost project — a widget for requesting a callback (with estimated wait time) or booking an appointment.
items.small-description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I built the frontend of an InPost widget that lets customers request a callback or book a time slot for a conversation.

key-points.title: Web component architecture
key-points.description: Full responsibility for the architecture: a complete web component (@angular/elements) with Shadow DOM isolation and runtime configuration via HTML attributes.

key-points.title: Self-contained bundle
key-points.description: Optimization of a self-contained bundle (inline assets, fonts, and translations) without additional requests.

key-points.title: Accessible reactive forms
key-points.description: Reactive forms with dynamic validation and keyboard-accessible dialogs (a11y).

items.title: Corporate Speech Analysis Platform
items.description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I developed a corporate speech analysis platform for a large call center — conversation analysis and consultant performance evaluation; uploading and processing recordings, evaluation, visualizations, and reporting.
items.small-description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I worked on a platform for a large call center used to analyze conversations and evaluate the quality of consultants' work.

key-points.title: Frontend architecture
key-points.description: Full responsibility for the application's frontend architecture.

key-points.title: Hierarchical permissions
key-points.description: Designed a comprehensive permission model inherited down the organizational structure (entity → client → project → campaign).

key-points.title: Corporate SSO integration
key-points.description: Integrated corporate SSO (Microsoft Azure AD / MSAL) with federated token exchange.

key-points.title: Audio-transcript sync
key-points.description: Interactive analysis interface with two-way synchronization of audio playback and time-stamped transcription.

items.title: Shopping Assistant Widget for Furniture Manufacturer
items.description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I built a shopping assistant widget that holds a conversation and presents tailored products.
items.small-description: As a frontend developer at Yarrl, I built the frontend of a shopping assistant widget that holds a conversation, presents tailored products, and guides customers through the complaint process.

key-points.title: Framework-free widget
key-points.description: Built the widget entirely from scratch in pure JavaScript, with Shadow DOM isolation.

key-points.title: Single-file embed
key-points.description: Modular architecture with everything bundled into a single file, ready to be dropped in.

items.title: Mobile Homes Configurator
items.description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I built an interactive platform for home configuration and pricing, supporting the sales process and reducing errors in order specifications.
items.small-description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I built an interactive mobile homes configurator that supports both the sales process and marketing.

key-points.title: Framework-free architecture
key-points.description: Built the entire application from scratch without frameworks – a proprietary, modular state management architecture in pure JavaScript.

key-points.title: Canvas texture editor
key-points.description: Built an interactive texture editor on HTML5 Canvas: drag-and-drop area masking, scaling, edge detection.

key-points.title: Live color matching
key-points.description: Custom color matching algorithm (RGB) for live dynamic texture replacement.

key-points.title: Backend & PDF offers
key-points.description: Native PHP/MySQL backend for saving configurations; client-side generation of PDF pricing offers.

items.title: Marketing Offer Generator
items.description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I created a generator for personalized, print-ready catalogs and offers.
items.small-description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I single-handedly created an offer generator that lets sales reps put together a print-ready, personalized marketing offer.

key-points.title: Inline editing & layout
key-points.description: Inline content editing, drag-and-drop upload, and photo cropping with automatic layout adjustment.

key-points.title: Image classification model
key-points.description: Custom image classification model categorizing photos by room, suggesting ready-made realizations in the configurator.

key-points.title: Client-side PDF export
key-points.description: Client-side rendering and export of finished catalogs to PDF.

items.title: Production Order System for Mobile Homes
items.description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I built a B2B-class system for configuring and managing production orders for mobile homes, connecting distributors, sales, and production.
items.small-description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I single-handedly built a B2B-class system for creating the production specification that mobile and modular homes are then manufactured from.

key-points.title: Angular & Firebase SPA
key-points.description: Independently built an SPA in Angular (Standalone Components) with a serverless backend on Firebase.

key-points.title: Schema-driven forms
key-points.description: Built dynamic reactive forms that automatically adjust to product options based on complex schemas from the database.

key-points.title: Real-time collaboration
key-points.description: Implemented real-time collaboration with lease-based session locking and role-based access control.

key-points.title: PDF production documents
key-points.description: Client-side generation of multi-page PDF production documents.

items.title: Complaint Handling System for Mobile Homes
items.description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I created a B2B2C platform for handling home complaints and service, with a full ticket history and clear status for the client, connecting production and the service team.
items.small-description: As a full-stack developer at Lark, I single-handedly created a B2B2C-class platform for submitting and handling complaints for modular homes.

key-points.title: Serverless architecture
key-points.description: Designed a serverless architecture connecting the frontend, a real-time database, and an event-driven notification system.

key-points.title: Complaints & notifications
key-points.description: Submitting complaints, cascading structure deletion, automated emails with localized change logs.

key-points.title: Full localization
key-points.description: Full localization of the interface and routing (ngx-translate-router).
